ko.title: 지원금 확대 종료로 ACA 보험료 급등: 수백만 미국인들의 공개 가입 기간 전망

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## 우편함에서 발견한 값비싼 놀라움

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: 전국적으로 건강보험개혁법(ACA) 마켓플레이스를 통해 직접 건강보험을 구매하는 사람들이 이번 가을 갱신 통지서를 열어보고 페이지 하단에 훨씬 더 커진 금액을 발견하고 있습니다.

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: 많은 경우, 이 인상 폭은 완만한 수준이 아닙니다. 일부 가입자는 작년에 비해 실질 보험료가 두 배 이상 오른 것을 목격하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: 이미 한 달 예산을 빠듯하게 꾸려가고 있는 가구에 이러한 변화는 보험 보장을 유지하느냐, 아니면 보험 없이 지내느냐의 차이를 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: 그 근본 원인은 단일 보험사의 결정이나 의료비 급등 때문만은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: 이는 지난 몇 년 동안 ACA 마켓플레이스 플랜을 이례적으로 저렴하게 유지해 주었던 일시적인 지원금 확대 조치로 거슬러 올라가며, 이 지원금 확대 조치가 만료될 예정이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## 어떻게 여기까지 왔는가

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: 팬데믹 기간 동안 의회는 ACA의 보험료 세액 공제를 일시적으로 확대하여 지원금 규모를 늘리고, 이전에는 소득이 너무 높아 지원 대상에서 제외되었던 중산층 가구까지 자격 요건을 확대했습니다.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: 이러한 확대된 세액 공제는 한 차례 더 연장되었지만, 항상 종료일이 예정된 일시적인 조치로 설계되었습니다.

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: 만료일이 다가옴에 따라 의원들은 지원금 확대를 연장할지, 그대로 만료되게 둘지, 아니면 다른 방식으로 대체할지를 두고 협상을 벌여왔습니다.

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: 지난겨울 워싱턴의 광범위한 예산 대치 상황 속에서 협상은 교착 상태에 빠졌고, 이번 가을 현재 연장 법안은 통과되지 않은 상태입니다.

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: 막판 조치가 없다면, 확대된 지원금은 ACA의 원래의 덜 관대한 지원금 공식으로 환원될 예정이며, 일부 가입자(특히 소득 자격 기준의 상한선에 가까운 가입자)는 지원금 자격을 완전히 잃을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## 인상 폭이 이토록 다양한 이유

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: 모든 사람이 동일한 규모의 인상을 겪는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: 그 영향은 다음과 같은 요인에 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **소득 수준** — 지원금 차단선에 가까운 가구일수록 지원을 완전히 잃을 가능성이 더 높습니다.

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **연령** — 이미 더 높은 기본 보험료를 내고 있는 고령 가입자들은 지원금이 줄어들 때 가장 큰 금액적 인상을 겪는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **주(State)** — 자체적인 추가 지원금을 제공하거나 마켓플레이스를 적극적으로 관리·운영하는 주는 다른 주에 비해 타격을 완화해 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **플랜 선택** — 더 높은 등급의 플랜에 가입한 사람들은 인상분의 일부를 상쇄하기 위해 더 저렴한 옵션으로 전환할 여지가 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: 여러 초당파 건강 정책 연구 단체들은 지원금 확대가 갱신되지 않을 경우, 내년에 마켓플레이스 가입자들의 본인 부담 보험료가 평균적으로 크게 상승할 수 있다고 전망했습니다. 특히 일시적 확대 조치의 혜택을 가장 많이 받았던 중산층 가정이 가장 높은 비율의 인상을 겪게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## 누가 영향을 받는가

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: 수천만 명으로 추산되는 미국인들이 ACA 마켓플레이스 플랜에 의존하고 있으며, 이들 중 상당수는 자영업자, 파트타임 근무자, 또는 단체 보장을 제공하지 않는 소규모 기업의 근로자입니다.

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: 마켓플레이스 가입 데이터를 추적하는 분석가들은 현재 가입자의 상당수가 의미 있는 수준의 비용 인상에 직면할 수 있으며, 일부는 훨씬 더 많은 비용을 지불하기보다 보장을 완전히 포기하는 쪽을 선택할 수 있다고 경고했습니다. 이러한 변화는 보험 위험 풀의 전반적인 규모와 건전성에도 영향을 미쳐, 남아 있는 사람들의 보험료를 훨씬 더 높일 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## 정치적 대치

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: 지원금 연장을 둘러싼 싸움은 더 광범위한 예산 협상과 뒤얽히게 되었습니다.

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: 지원금 확대 연장을 지지하는 측은 이를 만료되게 두는 것이 중산층 가정에 사실상의 세금 인상과 다름없으며, 최근 개선된 무보험률 추세를 역전시킬 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: 반면 연장을 반대하는 측은 일시적 지원금이 언제나 팬데믹 시기의 구제 조치였을 뿐이며, 이를 영구적으로 연장하는 것은 비용이 너무 많이 들고, 반복적인 단기 처방 대신 ACA의 구조적 개혁이 필요하다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽도 확실한 합의를 이끌어내지 못한 상황에서, 그 결과는 공개 가입 기간이 시작되기 직전이나 심지어 시작된 후에야 결정될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## 가입자가 지금 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: 건강 정책 전문가들은 일반적으로 현재 마켓플레이스 가입자들에게 다음과 같이 권장합니다.

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **작년 플랜이 여전히 가장 합리적일 것이라고 가정하지 마십시오.** 플랜 가격과 지원금 액수는 매년 크게 달라질 수 있으므로 공개 가입 기간 동안 다시 비교해 보십시오.

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **소득 및 가구 정보를 신속하게 업데이트하십시오.** 지원금 액수는 보고된 소득과 직접 연계되어 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **주 정부 운영 마켓플레이스를 확인하십시오.** 연방 지원금 외에 추가적인 재정 지원을 제공하는 경우가 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **공식 가입 마감일을 면밀히 주시하십시오.** 보장 공백이 생기면 치료의 단절이 발생할 수 있으며, 일부 주에서는 벌금이 부과될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## 이번 가을에 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: 대부분의 마켓플레이스 플랜에 대한 공개 가입은 보통 11월에 시작되므로, 가입자들이 결정을 내리기 전에 의회가 지원금을 연장하거나 수정할 수 있는 시간적 여유는 점점 줄어들고 있습니다.

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: 그 조치가 이루어질지, 그리고 어떤 형태로 이루어질지에 따라 내년 수백만 가구의 가계 예산이 결정될 것입니다.

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
segments.tr: 이 상황은 계속 변동하고 있으므로, 가입자들은 지원금 자격 및 보험료 비용에 대한 가장 최신의 개인 맞춤형 정보를 얻기 위해 공식 healthcare.gov 리소스나 해당 주의 마켓플레이스를 참조하시기 바랍니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 금융, 세무 또는 보험 관련 자문을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Consult a licensed insurance navigator or tax professional for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 귀하의 상황에 맞는 구체적인 안내를 받으려면 공인 보험 내비게이터나 세무 전문가와 상담하십시오.*

zh.title: 随着增强型补贴到期，ACA保费飙升：数百万美国人的开放注册期可能会是什么样子

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## 邮箱里的一份昂贵惊喜

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: 在全国范围内，通过《平价医疗法案》（ACA）市场购买个人健康保险的人们在今年秋天打开续保通知时，发现页面底部的数字要大得多。

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: 在许多情况下，这种跳涨并非温和的增长——一些参保人的净保费与去年相比翻了一倍多。

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: 对于那些已经在勉强维持每月预算的家庭来说，这种变化可能意味着能否保留保险与不得不放弃保险之间的区别。

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: 根本原因并非单一的保险公司决策，也不是医疗成本的单纯飙升。

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: 这可以追溯到过去几年使ACA市场计划异常实惠的一系列临时性增强补贴——而这些增强措施即将到期。

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## 我们是如何走到这一步的

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: 在疫情期间，国会暂时扩大了ACA的保费税收抵免，增加了补贴金额，并将资格扩大到以前因收入过高而无法获得帮助的中等收入家庭。

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: 这些增强型抵免额度又被延长了一次，但它们始终被设计为具有预定结束日期的临时措施。

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: 随着到期日的临近，立法者一直在就延长增强型补贴、让其失效或用其他方式取代它们进行谈判。

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: 去年冬天，由于华盛顿更广泛的预算僵局，谈判陷入停滞。截至今年秋季，尚未有任何延期法案签署成为法律。

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: 除非最后一刻采取行动，否则增强型补贴将恢复到ACA最初的、慷慨程度较低的补贴公式，而一些参保人——特别是那些处于收入资格范围上限的人——可能会完全失去补贴资格。

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## 为什么涨幅差异如此之大

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: 并非每个人都会看到相同幅度的增长。

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: 影响在很大程度上取决于：

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **收入水平** — 越接近补贴截止线的家庭，越有可能完全失去援助。

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **年龄** — 年龄较大的参保人，由于本身支付的基础保费就较高，在补贴缩减时往往会看到最大的金额增长。

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **州** — 那些增加了自己的补充补贴或运行主动管理市场的州，可能比其他州更能缓解这种冲击。

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **计划选择** — 选择更高级别计划的参保人可能有空间转向成本较低的选项，以抵消部分增长。

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: 多个无党派健康政策研究小组预测，如果增强型抵免额度不续期，明年市场参保人的平均自付保费成本可能会大幅上升——其中受影响最严重的是从临时扩张中受益最大的中等收入家庭。

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## 谁会受到影响

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: 据估计，数千万美国人依赖ACA市场计划，其中许多人是自雇人士、兼职工作者，或在不提供团体保险的小企业工作。

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: 追踪市场参保数据的分析师警告称，很大一部分现有参保人可能面临明显更高的成本，有些人可能会选择完全放弃保险，而不是支付高得多的费用——这种转变也可能影响保险风险池的整体规模和健康状况，从而可能推高剩余参保人的保费。

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## 政治僵局

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: 关于延长补贴的争论已经陷入了更广泛的预算谈判之中。

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: 支持延长增强型抵免额度的人认为，让其到期相当于对中产阶级家庭变相加税，并可能逆转最近在降低无保险率方面取得的进展。

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: 反对延长的人则认为，临时补贴始终只是疫情期间的救济措施，永久延长的成本太高，且ACA需要的是结构性改革，而不是反复的短期修补。

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: 由于双方都没有达成明确共识，结果可能要到开放注册期开始前夕——甚至开始之后——才能确定。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## 参保人现在可以做什么

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: 健康政策专家通常建议当前的参保人：

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **不要假设去年的计划仍然是最划算的。** 在开放注册期间重新选择，因为计划定价和补贴金额每年都会有显著变化。

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **及时更新收入和家庭信息**，因为补贴金额直接与申报的收入挂钩。

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **查看州级市场交易所**，它们有时会提供除联邦补贴之外的额外经济援助。

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **密切关注官方注册截止日期**，因为保险中断可能会导致护理缺口，并在某些州产生潜在罚款。

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## 今年秋天需要关注什么

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: 大多数市场计划的开放注册通常在11月开始，如果立法者选择在参保人锁定决定之前延长或修改补贴，国会采取行动的时间窗口正在缩小。

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: 这种情况是否会发生——以及以何种形式发生——将影响数百万家庭明年及以后的预算。

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
segments.tr: 这种情况仍然不稳定，建议参保人查阅官方 healthcare.gov 资源或其所在州的市场交易所，以获取关于补贴资格和保费成本的最新、个性化信息。

hi.title: ACA प्रीमियम बढ़ रहे हैं क्योंकि बढ़ी हुई सब्सिडी समाप्त हो रही है: लाखों अमेरिकियों के लिए ओपन एनरोलमेंट कैसा दिख सकता है

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## मेलबॉक्स में एक महंगा आश्चर्य

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: देश भर में, जो लोग अफोर्डेबल केयर एक्ट (ACA) मार्केटप्लेस के माध्यम से अपना स्वास्थ्य बीमा खरीदते हैं, वे इस गिरावट में नवीनीकरण नोटिस खोल रहे हैं और पृष्ठ के नीचे एक बहुत बड़ी संख्या पा रहे हैं।

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: कई मामलों में, यह उछाल मामूली वृद्धि नहीं है — कुछ नामांकित व्यक्ति देख रहे हैं कि उनके शुद्ध प्रीमियम पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में दोगुने से अधिक हो गए हैं।

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: पहले से ही मासिक बजट को खींच रहे परिवारों के लिए, इस तरह का बदलाव कवरेज बनाए रखने और इसके बिना रहने के बीच का अंतर हो सकता है।

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: इसका मूल कारण केवल किसी बीमाकर्ता का निर्णय या चिकित्सा लागत में वृद्धि नहीं है।

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: यह अस्थायी, बढ़ी हुई सब्सिडी के एक सेट का पता लगाता है जिसने पिछले कुछ वर्षों से ACA मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं को असामान्य रूप से किफायती बनाए रखा है — और वे संवर्द्धन समाप्त होने वाले हैं।

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## हम यहाँ कैसे पहुँचे

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: महामारी के दौरान, कांग्रेस ने अस्थायी रूप से ACA के प्रीमियम टैक्स क्रेडिट का विस्तार किया, जिससे सब्सिडी बड़ी हो गई और मध्यम आय वाले परिवारों तक पात्रता का विस्तार हुआ, जो पहले मदद के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करने के लिए बहुत अधिक कमाते थे।

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: उन संवर्धित क्रेडिटों को एक बार फिर बढ़ाया गया था लेकिन उन्हें हमेशा एक निर्धारित समाप्ति तिथि के साथ अस्थायी उपायों के रूप में डिज़ाइन किया गया था।

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे वह समाप्ति निकट आ रही है, कानून निर्माता बातचीत कर रहे हैं कि क्या बढ़ी हुई सब्सिडी का विस्तार किया जाए, उन्हें समाप्त होने दिया जाए, या उन्हें एक अलग दृष्टिकोण के साथ प्रतिस्थापित किया जाए।

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: पिछली सर्दियों में वाशिंगटन में व्यापक बजट गतिरोध के बीच बातचीत रुक गई, और इस गिरावट तक, किसी भी विस्तार को कानून में हस्ताक्षरित नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: अंतिम समय की कार्रवाई को छोड़कर, बढ़ी हुई सब्सिडी ACA के मूल, कम उदार सब्सिडी फॉर्मूले पर वापस जाने के लिए तैयार हैं, और कुछ नामांकित व्यक्ति — विशेष रूप से आय पात्रता सीमा के ऊपरी छोर के पास वाले — सब्सिडी पात्रता पूरी तरह से खो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## वृद्धि इतनी अलग क्यों है

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: हर कोई वृद्धि का समान आकार नहीं देखेगा।

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: प्रभाव काफी हद तक इस पर निर्भर करता है:

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **आय स्तर** — सब्सिडी कटऑफ के करीब वाले परिवारों के पूरी तरह से सहायता खोने की संभावना अधिक है।

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **आयु** — वृद्ध नामांकित व्यक्ति, जो पहले से ही उच्च आधार प्रीमियम का भुगतान करते हैं, सब्सिडी कम होने पर सबसे बड़ी डॉलर वृद्धि देखते हैं।

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **राज्य** — जिन राज्यों ने अपनी पूरक सब्सिडी जोड़ी है या सक्रिय-प्रबंधन मार्केटप्लेस चलाते हैं, वे दूसरों की तुलना में झटके को अधिक कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **योजना का विकल्प** — उच्च-स्तरीय योजनाओं पर नामांकित लोगों के पास वृद्धि के कुछ हिस्से की भरपाई करने के लिए कम लागत वाले विकल्पों पर स्विच करने की गुंजाइश हो सकती है।

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: कई गैर-पक्षपाती स्वास्थ्य नीति अनुसंधान समूहों ने अनुमान लगाया है कि, औसतन, यदि बढ़ी हुई क्रेडिट का नवीनीकरण नहीं किया जाता है तो अगले साल मार्केटप्लेस नामांकित लोगों के लिए जेब से प्रीमियम लागत काफी बढ़ सकती है — जिसमें सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत वृद्धि मध्यम आय वाले परिवारों पर पड़ रही है, जिन्हें अस्थायी विस्तार से सबसे अधिक लाभ हुआ था।

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## कौन प्रभावित है

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: अनुमानित करोड़ों अमेरिकी ACA मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं पर निर्भर हैं, जिनमें से कई स्व-रोजगार वाले हैं, अंशकालिक काम करते हैं, या छोटे व्यवसायों के लिए काम करते हैं जो समूह कवरेज प्रदान नहीं करते हैं।

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: मार्केटप्लेस नामांकन डेटा को ट्रैक करने वाले विश्लेषकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि वर्तमान नामांकित लोगों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा काफी अधिक लागत का सामना कर सकता है, और कुछ काफी अधिक भुगतान करने के बजाय कवरेज को पूरी तरह से छोड़ने का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं — एक ऐसा बदलाव जो बीमा जोखिम पूल के समग्र आकार और स्वास्थ्य को भी प्रभावित कर सकता है, जो संभावित रूप से उन लोगों के लिए प्रीमियम को और भी अधिक बढ़ा सकता है जो बने रहते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## राजनीतिक गतिरोध

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: सब्सिडी बढ़ाने को लेकर लड़ाई व्यापक बजट वार्ताओं में उलझ गई है।

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: बढ़ी हुई क्रेडिट का विस्तार करने के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि उन्हें समाप्त होने देना मध्यम वर्गीय परिवारों पर एक वास्तविक कर वृद्धि के बराबर है और यह बीमा रहित दर में हालिया लाभ को उलट सकता है।

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: उन्हें बढ़ाने के आलोचकों का तर्क है कि अस्थायी सब्सिडी हमेशा महामारी-युग की राहत के लिए थी, कि उन्हें स्थायी रूप से बढ़ाना महंगा है, और बार-बार अल्पकालिक पैच के बजाय ACA में संरचनात्मक सुधारों की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: किसी भी पक्ष के पास स्पष्ट सहमति न होने के कारण, परिणाम तब तक तय नहीं हो सकता है जब तक कि ओपन एनरोलमेंट शुरू नहीं हो जाता — या उसके बाद भी।

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## नामांकित व्यक्ति अब क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: स्वास्थ्य नीति विशेषज्ञ आम तौर पर सलाह देते हैं कि वर्तमान मार्केटप्लेस नामांकित व्यक्ति:

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **यह न मानें कि पिछले साल की योजना अभी भी सबसे अच्छा मूल्य है।** ओपन एनरोलमेंट के दौरान फिर से खरीदारी करें, क्योंकि योजना की कीमत और सब्सिडी की राशि साल-दर-साल काफी बदल सकती है।

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **आय और घरेलू जानकारी को तुरंत अपडेट करें**, क्योंकि सब्सिडी की राशि सीधे रिपोर्ट की गई आय से जुड़ी होती है।

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **राज्य-आधारित मार्केटप्लेस एक्सचेंज की जाँच करें**, जो कभी-कभी संघीय सब्सिडी से परे अतिरिक्त वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **आधिकारिक नामांकन समय सीमा पर बारीकी से नज़र रखें**, क्योंकि कवरेज में चूक देखभाल में अंतराल और कुछ राज्यों में संभावित दंड पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## इस गिरावट में क्या देखना है

segments.tr: अधिकांश मार्केटप्लेस योजनाओं के लिए ओपन एनरोलमेंट आमतौर पर नवंबर में शुरू होता है, जिससे कांग्रेस को कार्य करने के लिए एक सीमित समय मिलता है यदि कानून निर्माता नामांकित लोगों के निर्णय लेने से पहले सब्सिडी का विस्तार या संशोधन करना चुनते हैं।

es.title: Las primas de la ACA se disparan a medida que expiran los subsidios mejorados: cómo podría ser la inscripción abierta para millones de estadounidenses

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## Una sorpresa costosa en el buzón

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: En todo el país, las personas que compran su propio seguro médico a través del mercado de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud a Bajo Precio (ACA) están abriendo avisos de renovación este otoño y encontrando un número mucho mayor al pie de la página.

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: En muchos casos, el salto no es un aumento modesto; algunos afiliados están viendo que sus primas netas se más que duplican en comparación con el año pasado.

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: Para los hogares que ya estiran un presupuesto mensual, ese tipo de cambio puede marcar la diferencia entre mantener la cobertura y quedarse sin ella.

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: La causa principal no es la decisión de una sola aseguradora ni un repunte en los costos médicos por sí solos.

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: Se remonta a un conjunto de subsidios temporales y mejorados que han mantenido los planes del mercado de la ACA inusualmente accesibles durante los últimos años, y esas mejoras están a punto de expirar.

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## Cómo llegamos aquí

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: Durante la pandemia, el Congreso expandió temporalmente los créditos fiscales para primas de la ACA, haciendo que los subsidios fueran más grandes y extendiendo la elegibilidad a hogares de ingresos medios que anteriormente ganaban demasiado para calificar para ayuda.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: Esos créditos mejorados se extendieron una vez más, pero siempre fueron diseñados como medidas temporales con una fecha de finalización programada.

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: A medida que se acerca esa expiración, los legisladores han estado negociando si deben extender los subsidios mejorados, dejar que caduquen o reemplazarlos con un enfoque diferente.

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: Las conversaciones se estancaron en medio de un enfrentamiento presupuestario más amplio en Washington el invierno pasado, y a partir de este otoño, no se ha firmado ninguna extensión en ley.

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: A menos que haya una acción de último minuto, los subsidios mejorados están programados para volver a la fórmula de subsidios original y menos generosa de la ACA, y algunos afiliados —particularmente aquellos cerca del extremo superior del rango de elegibilidad de ingresos— podrían perder por completo la elegibilidad para los subsidios.

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## Por qué varían tanto los aumentos

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: No todos verán el mismo tamaño de aumento.

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: El impacto depende en gran medida de:

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **Nivel de ingresos** — Los hogares más cercanos al límite de los subsidios tienen más probabilidades de perder la asistencia por completo.

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **Edad** — Los afiliados mayores, que ya pagan primas base más altas, tienden a ver los mayores aumentos en dólares cuando los subsidios se reducen.

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **Estado** — Los estados que han añadido sus propios subsidios suplementarios o que operan mercados de gestión activa pueden amortiguar el golpe más que otros.

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **Elección de plan** — Los afiliados en planes de niveles superiores pueden tener margen para cambiar a opciones de menor costo para compensar parte del aumento.

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: Múltiples grupos de investigación de políticas de salud no partidistas han proyectado que, en promedio, los costos de primas de bolsillo para los afiliados del mercado podrían aumentar sustancialmente el próximo año si los créditos mejorados no se renuevan, y los aumentos porcentuales más pronunciados recaerán en las familias de ingresos medios que más se beneficiaron de la expansión temporal.

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## Quiénes están afectados

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: Se estima que decenas de millones de estadounidenses dependen de los planes del mercado de la ACA; muchos de ellos son trabajadores independientes, trabajan a tiempo parcial o trabajan para pequeñas empresas que no ofrecen cobertura grupal.

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: Los analistas que rastrean los datos de inscripción en el mercado han advertido que una gran parte de los afiliados actuales podría enfrentar costos significativamente más altos, y algunos pueden optar por abandonar la cobertura por completo en lugar de pagar mucho más, un cambio que también podría afectar el tamaño general y la salud del grupo de riesgo de seguros, elevando potencialmente las primas aún más para quienes permanezcan.

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## El enfrentamiento político

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: La pelea sobre la extensión de los subsidios se ha enredado en negociaciones presupuestarias más amplias.

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: Los partidarios de extender los créditos mejorados argumentan que dejar que expiren equivale a un aumento de impuestos de facto sobre las familias de clase media y podría revertir los recientes avances en la tasa de personas sin seguro.

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: Los críticos de extenderlos argumentan que los subsidios temporales siempre pretendieron ser un alivio de la era de la pandemia, que son costosos de extender permanentemente y que se necesitan reformas estructurales en la ACA en lugar de parches a corto plazo repetidos.

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: Sin que ninguna de las partes tenga un consenso claro, es posible que el resultado no se resuelva hasta muy cerca de, o incluso después de, que comience la inscripción abierta.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los afiliados ahora

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: Los expertos en políticas de salud generalmente recomiendan que los afiliados actuales del mercado:

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **No asuman que el plan del año pasado sigue siendo el mejor valor.** Vuelvan a cotizar durante la inscripción abierta, ya que los precios de los planes y los montos de los subsidios pueden cambiar significativamente de año en año.

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **Actualicen la información de ingresos y del hogar con prontitud**, ya que los montos de los subsidios están vinculados directamente a los ingresos reportados.

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **Verifiquen los intercambios del mercado basados en el estado**, los cuales a veces ofrecen ayuda financiera adicional más allá de los subsidios federales.

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **Vigilen de cerca los plazos oficiales de inscripción**, ya que un lapso en la cobertura puede crear brechas en la atención y posibles sanciones en algunos estados.

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## Qué observar este otoño

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: La inscripción abierta para la mayoría de los planes del mercado generalmente comienza en noviembre, lo que le da al Congreso un margen cada vez más estrecho para actuar si los legisladores deciden extender o modificar los subsidios antes de que los afiliados fijen sus decisiones.

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: Si eso sucede —y en qué forma— dará forma a los presupuestos familiares de millones de familias hasta bien entrado el próximo año.

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
segments.tr: Esta situación sigue siendo cambiante, y se anima a los afiliados a consultar los recursos oficiales de healthcare.gov o el mercado de intercambio de su estado para obtener la información más actualizada y personalizada sobre la elegibilidad para los subsidios y los costos de las primas.

fr.title: Les primes ACA montent en flèche avec l'expiration des subventions renforcées : À quoi pourrait ressembler la période d'inscription ouverte pour des millions d'Américains

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## Une surprise coûteuse dans la boîte aux lettres

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: Dans tout le pays, les personnes qui achètent leur propre assurance maladie via le marché de l'Affordable Care Act (ACA) ouvrent leurs avis de renouvellement cet automne et découvrent un chiffre beaucoup plus élevé au bas de la page.

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: Dans de nombreux cas, la hausse n'est pas une modeste augmentation — certains inscrits voient leurs primes nettes plus que doubler par rapport à l'année dernière.

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages qui étirent déjà leur budget mensuel, ce type de changement peut faire la différence entre conserver une couverture et s'en passer.

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: La cause fondamentale n'est pas la décision d'un seul assureur ni une hausse isolée des coûts médicaux.

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: Elle remonte à un ensemble de subventions temporaires et renforcées qui ont maintenu les plans du marché ACA à un niveau exceptionnellement abordable ces dernières années — et ces renforcements sont sur le point d'expirer.

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## Comment nous en sommes arrivés là

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: Pendant la pandémie, le Congrès a temporairement élargi les crédits d'impôt pour primes de l'ACA, augmentant le montant des subventions et étendant l'admissibilité aux ménages à revenus moyens qui gagnaient auparavant trop pour bénéficier d'une aide.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: Ces crédits renforcés ont été prolongés une fois de plus, mais ont toujours été conçus comme des mesures temporaires avec une date de fin prévue.

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: À l'approche de cette expiration, les législateurs ont négocié pour savoir s'il fallait prolonger les subventions renforcées, les laisser caduques ou les remplacer par une approche différente.

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: Les discussions ont bloqué au milieu d'une impasse budgétaire plus large à Washington l'hiver dernier, et cet automne, aucune prolongation n'a été promulguée.

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: Sauf action de dernière minute, les subventions renforcées doivent revenir à la formule de subvention originale de l'ACA, moins généreuse, et certains inscrits — en particulier ceux qui se situent dans la tranche supérieure d'admissibilité selon le revenu — pourraient perdre complètement leur droit aux subventions.

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les augmentations varient autant

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: Tout le monde ne verra pas la même ampleur d'augmentation.

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: L'impact dépend fortement de :

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **Niveau de revenu** — Les ménages plus proches du seuil de subvention sont plus susceptibles de perdre entièrement l'assistance.

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **Âge** — Les inscrits plus âgés, qui paient déjà des primes de base plus élevées, ont tendance à subir les plus fortes augmentations en dollars lorsque les subventions diminuent.

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **État** — Les États qui ont ajouté leurs propres subventions complémentaires ou qui gèrent des marchés à gestion active peuvent amortir le choc plus que d'autres.

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **Choix du plan** — Les inscrits à des plans de niveau supérieur peuvent avoir la possibilité de passer à des options à moindre coût pour compenser une partie de l'augmentation.

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: Plusieurs groupes de recherche indépendants en politiques de santé ont projeté qu'en moyenne, les coûts de prime restants à la charge des inscrits au marché pourraient augmenter considérablement l'année prochaine si les crédits renforcés ne sont pas renouvelés — les augmentations en pourcentage les plus fortes frappant les familles à revenus moyens qui ont le plus bénéficié de l'extension temporaire.

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est touché

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: On estime que des dizaines de millions d'Américains dépendent des plans du marché ACA, dont beaucoup sont des travailleurs indépendants, des travailleurs à temps partiel ou des employés de petites entreprises qui n'offrent pas de couverture de groupe.

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent les données d'inscription au marché ont averti qu'une grande proportion des inscrits actuels pourrait faire face à des coûts nettement plus élevés, et certains pourraient choisir d'abandonner toute couverture plutôt que de payer beaucoup plus — un changement qui pourrait également affecter la taille globale et la santé du groupe de mutualisation des risques d'assurance, augmentant potentiellement encore plus les primes pour ceux qui restent.

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## L'impasse politique

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: La bataille autour de la prolongation des subventions s'est enchevêtrée dans des négociations budgétaires plus vastes.

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: Les partisans de la prolongation des crédits renforcés soutiennent que les laisser expirer équivaut à une hausse d'impôt de facto pour les familles de la classe moyenne et pourrait inverser les progrès récents du taux de personnes non assurées.

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: Les critiques de leur prolongation soutiennent que les subventions temporaires étaient uniquement destinées à être un secours de l'ère pandémique, qu'elles sont coûteuses à prolonger de manière permanente, et que des réformes structurelles de l'ACA sont nécessaires plutôt que des correctifs à court terme répétés.

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: Aucun des deux camps n'obtenant un consensus clair, le résultat pourrait ne pas être réglé avant — ou même après — le début de la période d'inscription ouverte.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## Ce que les inscrits peuvent faire maintenant

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: Les experts en politique de santé recommandent généralement aux inscrits actuels du marché de :

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **Ne pas supposer que le plan de l'année dernière reste la meilleure option.** Comparez à nouveau les offres pendant l'inscription ouverte, car le prix des plans et le montant des subventions peuvent varier considérablement d'une année sur l'autre.

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **Mettre à jour rapidement les informations sur le revenu et le ménage**, car le montant des subventions est directement lié au revenu déclaré.

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **Consulter les plateformes d'échange du marché au niveau de l'État**, qui offrent parfois une aide financière supplémentaire au-delà des subventions fédérales.

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **Suivre de près les dates limites d'inscription officielles**, car une interruption de couverture peut entraîner des lacunes dans les soins et de potentielles pénalités dans certains États.

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller cet automne

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: L'inscription ouverte pour la plupart des plans du marché commence généralement en novembre, offrant au Congrès une fenêtre de tir réduite pour agir si les législateurs choisissent de prolonger ou de modifier les subventions avant que les inscrits ne verrouillent leurs décisions.

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: Que cela se produise — et sous quelle forme — façonnera le budget des ménages de millions de familles bien au-delà de l'année prochaine.

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
segments.tr: Cette situation reste évolutive, et les inscrits sont encouragés à consulter les ressources officielles de healthcare.gov ou la plateforme du marché de leur État pour obtenir les informations personnalisées les plus récentes sur l'admissibilité aux subventions et le coût des primes.

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff

in.title: Premi ACA Melonjak saat Subsidi Tambahan Berakhir: Gambaran Pendaftaran Terbuka Bagi Jutaan Warga Amerika

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## Kejutan Berbiaya Mahal di Kotak Surat

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: Di seluruh negeri, orang-orang yang membeli asuransi kesehatan mereka sendiri melalui pasar Affordable Care Act (ACA) membuka pemberitahuan perpanjangan musim gugur ini dan menemukan angka yang jauh lebih besar di bagian bawah halaman.

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: Dalam banyak kasus, lonjakan ini bukanlah peningkatan yang kecil — beberapa peserta melihat premi bersih mereka melonjak lebih dari dua kali lipat dibandingkan tahun lalu.

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga yang sudah memperketat anggaran bulanan, perubahan semacam itu bisa menjadi pembeda antara mempertahankan perlindungan asuransi atau tidak memilikinya sama sekali.

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: Penyebab utamanya bukanlah keputusan tunggal perusahaan asuransi atau semata-mata kenaikan biaya medis.

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: Ini berakar pada serangkaian subsidi tambahan sementara yang telah menjaga rencana pasar ACA tetap sangat terjangkau selama beberapa tahun terakhir — dan subsidi tambahan tersebut dijadwalkan akan berakhir.

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Kita Sampai di Sini

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: Selama pandemi, Kongres memperluas kredit pajak premi ACA secara sementara, memperbesar subsidi dan memperluas kelayakan ke rumah tangga berpenghasilan menengah yang sebelumnya berpenghasilan terlalu tinggi untuk memenuhi syarat mendapatkan bantuan.

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: Kredit tambahan tersebut sempat diperpanjang sekali lagi, tetapi selalu dirancang sebagai langkah sementara dengan tanggal berakhir yang telah dijadwalkan.

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: Menjelang tanggal berakhir tersebut, para pembuat undang-undang telah bernegosiasi apakah akan memperpanjang subsidi tambahan, membiarkannya berakhir, atau menggantinya dengan pendekatan lain.

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: Pembahasan mengalami kebuntuan di tengah perdebatan anggaran yang lebih luas di Washington musim dingin lalu, dan hingga musim gugur ini, belum ada perpanjangan yang disahkan menjadi undang-undang.

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: Kecuali ada tindakan di menit-menit terakhir, subsidi tambahan akan kembali ke formula subsidi asli ACA yang kurang murah hati, dan beberapa peserta — terutama mereka yang mendekati batas atas rentang kelayakan pendapatan — dapat kehilangan kelayakan subsidi sama sekali.

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kenaikannya Sangat Bervariasi

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: Tidak semua orang akan melihat besaran kenaikan yang sama.

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: Dampaknya sangat bergantung pada:

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat pendapatan** — Rumah tangga yang lebih dekat dengan batas pemotongan subsidi lebih mungkin kehilangan bantuan secara total.

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **Usia** — Peserta yang lebih tua, yang sudah membayar premi dasar lebih tinggi, cenderung melihat kenaikan nominal terbesar saat subsidi berkurang.

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **Nagara bagian** — Negara bagian yang telah menambahkan subsidi suplemental mereka sendiri atau menjalankan pasar manajemen aktif mungkin dapat meringankan dampak tersebut lebih baik daripada yang lain.

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **Pilihan rencana** — Peserta pada rencana tingkat lebih tinggi mungkin memiliki ruang untuk beralih ke opsi berbiaya lebih rendah untuk mengimbangi sebagian kenaikan.

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: Beberapa kelompok riset kebijakan kesehatan nonpartisan telah memproyeksikan bahwa, rata-rata, biaya premi yang ditanggung sendiri oleh peserta pasar dapat naik secara signifikan tahun depan jika kredit tambahan tidak diperbarui — dengan persentase kenaikan tertinggi menimpa keluarga berpenghasilan menengah yang paling diuntungkan dari perluasan sementara tersebut.

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang Terdampak

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: Diperkirakan puluhan juta warga Amerika mengandalkan rencana pasar ACA, banyak di antaranya adalah pekerja mandiri, pekerja paruh waktu, atau bekerja untuk usaha kecil yang tidak menawarkan perlindungan kelompok.

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: Analis yang memantau data pendaftaran pasar telah memperingatkan bahwa sebagian besar peserta saat ini dapat menghadapi biaya yang signifikan lebih tinggi, dan beberapa mungkin memilih untuk melepas perlindungan daripada membayar jauh lebih mahal — sebuah pergeseran yang juga dapat memengaruhi ukuran keseluruhan dan kesehatan kumpulan risiko asuransi, berpotensi mendorong premi menjadi lebih tinggi bagi mereka yang tersisa.

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## Kebuntuan Politik

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: Perdebatan mengenai perpanjangan subsidi telah terikat dalam negosiasi anggaran yang lebih luas.

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: Pendukung perpanjangan kredit tambahan berargumen bahwa membiarkannya berakhir sama saja dengan kenaikan pajak de facto bagi keluarga kelas menengah dan dapat membalikkan pencapaian penurunan tingkat masyarakat tanpa asuransi baru-baru ini.

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: Kritikus perpanjangan berargumen bahwa subsidi sementara sejak awal dimaksudkan sebagai bantuan era pandemi, membutuhkan biaya mahal untuk diperpanjang secara permanen, dan bahwa reformasi struktural pada ACA lebih dibutuhkan daripada perbaikan jangka pendek yang berulang.

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: Dengan tidak adanya konsensus yang jelas dari kedua belah pihak, hasilnya mungkin tidak akan pasti sampai mendekati — atau bahkan setelah — pendaftaran terbuka dimulai.

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Bisa Dilakukan Peserta Sekarang

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: Pakar kebijakan kesehatan umumnya merekomendasikan agar peserta pasar saat ini:

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **Jangan menganggap rencana tahun lalu masih yang terbaik.** Bandingkan kembali pilihan selama pendaftaran terbuka, karena harga rencana dan jumlah subsidi dapat bergeser secara signifikan dari tahun ke tahun.

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 3. **Perbarui informasi pendapatan dan rumah tangga dengan segera**, karena jumlah subsidi terikat langsung dengan pendapatan yang dilaporkan.

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **Periksa bursa pasar berbasis negara bagian**, yang terkadang menawarkan bantuan keuangan tambahan di luar subsidi federal.

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **Pantau tenggat waktu pendaftaran resmi dengan saksama**, karena terputusnya perlindungan dapat menimbulkan celah dalam perawatan dan potensi denda di beberapa negara bagian.

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## Hal yang Perlu Dipantau Musim Gugur Ini

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: Pendaftaran terbuka untuk sebagian besar rencana pasar biasanya dimulai pada bulan November, memberikan Kongres waktu yang semakin sempit untuk bertindak jika pembuat undang-undang memilih untuk memperpanjang atau memodifikasi subsidi sebelum peserta mengunci keputusan mereka.

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: Apakah hal itu terjadi — dan dalam bentuk apa — akan membentuk anggaran rumah tangga bagi jutaan keluarga hingga tahun depan.

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
segments.tr: Situasi ini masih dinamis, dan peserta dianjurkan untuk berkonsultasi dengan sumber daya resmi healthcare.gov atau bursa pasar negara bagian mereka untuk mendapatkan informasi paling terbaru dan terpersonalisasi mengenai kelayakan subsidi dan biaya premi.

ja.title: 拡充された補助金の期限切れに伴いACA保険料が急騰：数百万人の米国人にとってのオープン・エンロールメントの行方

segments.src: ## A Costly Surprise in the Mailbox
segments.tr: ## 郵便受けに届いた、手痛いサプライズ

segments.src: Across the country, people who buy their own health insurance through the Affordable Care Act (ACA) marketplace are opening renewal notices this fall and finding a much bigger number at the bottom of the page.
segments.tr: 全米で、医療保険制度改革（ACA）のマーケットプレイスを通じて個人向け医療保険を購入している人々が、この秋に更新通知を開き、ページ下部に記載された大幅に高くなった金額を目にしています。

segments.src: In many cases, the jump isn't a modest increase — some enrollees are seeing their net premiums more than double compared to last year.
segments.tr: 多くの場合、その上昇幅はわずかなものではありません。一部の加入者では、自己負担する実質保険料が昨年に比べて2倍以上に跳ね上がっています。

segments.src: For households already stretching a monthly budget, that kind of shift can be the difference between keeping coverage and going without it.
segments.tr: 毎月の家計をすでに切り詰めている世帯にとって、このような変化は、保険への加入を維持するか、無保険で過ごすかの分かれ目になりかねません。

segments.src: The root cause isn't a single insurer decision or a spike in medical costs alone.
segments.tr: その根本的な原因は、単一の保険会社の決定や医療費の急騰だけではありません。

segments.src: It traces back to a set of temporary, enhanced subsidies that have kept ACA marketplace plans unusually affordable for the past few years — and those enhancements are set to expire.
segments.tr: それは、ここ数年ACAマーケットプレイスのプランを異例の低価格に抑えてきた、一連の「一時的な拡充補助金」に端を発しています。そして、その拡充措置が期限切れを迎えようとしているのです。

segments.src: ## How We Got Here
segments.tr: ## これまでの経緯

segments.src: During the pandemic, Congress temporarily expanded the ACA's premium tax credits, making subsidies larger and extending eligibility to middle-income households that previously earned too much to qualify for help.
segments.tr: パンデミックの間、議会はACAの保険料税額控除を一時的に拡大し、補助金額を増やすとともに、それまでは所得が高すぎて支援の対象外だった中間所得世帯にも受給資格を広げました。

segments.src: Those enhanced credits were extended once more but were always designed as temporary measures with a scheduled end date.
segments.tr: これらの拡充された控除はもう一度延長されましたが、常に終了日が予定された一時的な措置として設計されていました。

segments.src: As that expiration approaches, lawmakers have been negotiating whether to extend the enhanced subsidies, let them lapse, or replace them with a different approach.
segments.tr: その期限が近づくにつれ、議員たちは拡充補助金を延長するか、失効させるか、あるいは別の方法に置き換えるかについて交渉を続けてきました。

segments.src: Talks stalled amid a broader budget standoff in Washington last winter, and as of this fall, no extension has been signed into law.
segments.tr: 昨冬のワシントンにおける広範な予算対立の中で交渉は停滞し、この秋の時点で延長法案は成立していません。

segments.src: Barring last-minute action, the enhanced subsidies are set to revert to the ACA's original, less generous subsidy formula, and some enrollees — particularly those near the upper end of the income eligibility range — could lose subsidy eligibility altogether.
segments.tr: 土壇場での対応がない限り、拡充補助金はACA本来の、より手薄な補助金算出式へと戻ることになり、一部の加入者（特に所得制限の上限に近い層）は補助金の受給資格を完全に失う可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Why the Increases Vary So Much
segments.tr: ## なぜこれほど上昇幅に差があるのか

segments.src: Not everyone will see the same size of increase.
segments.tr: 全員が同じ規模の値上げに直面するわけではありません。

segments.src: The impact depends heavily on:
segments.tr: その影響は、以下に大きく左右されます：

segments.src: - **Income level** — Households closer to the subsidy cutoff are more likely to lose assistance entirely.
segments.tr: - **所得水準** — 補助金打ち切りの境界線に近い世帯ほど、支援を完全に失う可能性が高くなります。

segments.src: - **Age** — Older enrollees, who already pay higher base premiums, tend to see the largest dollar increases when subsidies shrink.
segments.tr: - **年齢** — もともと基本保険料が高い高齢の加入者ほど、補助金が縮小した際に金額ベースで最大の引き上げに直面する傾向があります。

segments.src: - **State** — States that have added their own supplemental subsidies or run active-management marketplaces may cushion the blow more than others.
segments.tr: - **州** — 独自の追加補助金を導入している州や、マーケットプレイスを積極的に管理・運営している州は、他州よりも打撃を和らげることができるかもしれません。

segments.src: - **Plan choice** — Enrollees on higher-tier plans may have room to shift to lower-cost options to offset some of the increase.
segments.tr: - **プランの選択** — 上位ランクのプランに加入している人は、より低価格の選択肢に切り替えることで、値上げ分の一部を相殺する余地があります。

segments.src: Multiple nonpartisan health policy research groups have projected that, on average, out-of-pocket premium costs for marketplace enrollees could rise substantially next year if the enhanced credits are not renewed — with the steepest percentage increases falling on middle-income families who benefited most from the temporary expansion.
segments.tr: 複数の超党派の医療政策研究グループは、拡充控除が更新されない場合、来年のマーケットプレイス加入者の平均自己負担保険料は大幅に上昇する可能性があると予測しています。特に、一時的な拡大措置から最も恩恵を受けていた中間所得層の世帯で、上昇率が最も高くなるとみられています。

segments.src: ## Who's Affected
segments.tr: ## 誰が影響を受けるのか

segments.src: An estimated tens of millions of Americans rely on ACA marketplace plans, many of whom are self-employed, work part-time, or work for small businesses that don't offer group coverage.
segments.tr: 推定で数千万人の米国人がACAマーケットプレイスのプランに依存しており、その多くは自営業者、パートタイム労働者、または団体保険を提供していない小規模企業の従業員です。

segments.src: Analysts tracking marketplace enrollment data have warned that a large share of current enrollees could face meaningfully higher costs, and some may choose to drop coverage altogether rather than pay significantly more — a shift that could also affect the overall size and health of the insurance risk pool, potentially pushing premiums even higher for those who remain.
segments.tr: マーケットプレイスの加入データを追跡しているアナリストは、現在の加入者の大部分が著しく高いコストに直面する可能性があり、大幅な負担増を嫌って保険への加入自体をやめる選択をする人も出てくるだろうと警告しています。この変化は、保険のリスクプールの全体的な規模や健全性にも影響を与え、残った人々の保険料をさらに押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## The Political Standoff
segments.tr: ## 政治的な対立

segments.src: The fight over extending the subsidies has become tangled in broader budget negotiations.
segments.tr: 補助金延長をめぐる争いは、より広範な予算交渉ともつれ合っています。

segments.src: Supporters of extending the enhanced credits argue that letting them expire amounts to a de facto tax increase on middle-class families and could reverse recent gains in the uninsured rate.
segments.tr: 拡充控除の延長を支持する人々は、補助金を失効させることは中間層世帯に対する事実上の増税に等しく、近年の無保険率の改善傾向を逆行させかねないと主張しています。

segments.src: Critics of extending them argue the temporary subsidies were always meant to be pandemic-era relief, that they're costly to extend permanently, and that structural reforms to the ACA are needed instead of repeated short-term patches.
segments.tr: 一方、延長に反対する人々は、一時的な補助金はあくまでパンデミック期の救済措置であり、恒久的な延長には多大なコストがかかること、そして繰り返される短期的な応急処置ではなく、ACAの構造的な改革が必要であると主張しています。

segments.src: With neither side holding a clear consensus, the outcome may not be settled until very close to — or even after — open enrollment begins.
segments.tr: 双方ともに明確な合意形成に至っておらず、その結果はオープン・エンロールメント（登録期間）が始まる直前、あるいは始まった後まで決着しない可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What Enrollees Can Do Now
segments.tr: ## 加入者が今できること

segments.src: Health policy experts generally recommend that current marketplace enrollees:
segments.tr: 医療政策の専門家は一般的に、現在のマーケットプレイス加入者に対して以下のことを推奨しています：

segments.src: 1. **Don't assume last year's plan is still the best value.** Re-shop during open enrollment, since plan pricing and subsidy amounts can shift significantly year to year.
segments.tr: 1. **昨年のプランが今も最適だと思い込まないこと。** プランの価格や補助金の額は年によって大きく変動するため、オープン・エンロールメント期間中に再度プランを比較検討してください。

segments.src: 2. **Update income and household information promptly**, since subsidy amounts are tied directly to reported income.
segments.tr: 2. **所得や世帯情報を速やかに更新すること。** 補助金の額は申告された所得に直接連動するためです。

segments.src: 3. **Check state-based marketplace exchanges**, which sometimes offer additional financial help beyond federal subsidies.
segments.tr: 3. **州独自のマーケットプレイスを確認すること。** 連邦政府の補助金以外に、追加の財政支援を提供している場合があります。

segments.src: 4. **Watch official enrollment deadlines closely**, since a lapse in coverage can create gaps in care and potential penalties in some states.
segments.tr: 4. **公式の登録締め切りを厳守すること。** 保険の空白期間が生じると、医療を受けられなくなったり、一部の州ではペナルティが科されたりする可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What to Watch This Fall
segments.tr: ## この秋に注目すべき点

segments.src: Open enrollment for most marketplace plans typically begins in November, giving Congress a narrowing window to act if lawmakers choose to extend or modify the subsidies before enrollees lock in decisions.
segments.tr: ほとんどのマーケットプレイス・プランのオープン・エンロールメントは通常11月に始まります。加入者が最終決定を下す前に議会が補助金の延長や修正を行う場合、残された時間は少なくなっています。

segments.src: Whether that happens — and in what form — will shape household budgets for millions of families well into next year.
segments.tr: それが実現するかどうか、そしてどのような形になるかが、来年にかけて数百万世帯の家計を左右することになります。

segments.src: This situation remains fluid, and enrollees are encouraged to consult official healthcare.gov resources or their state's marketplace exchange for the most current, personalized information about subsidy eligibility and premium costs.
